_comment: The nine sections of the brief (docs/PRD.md section 3) in their fixed order, with what arrives in which milestone (docs/new-build/07-implementation-roadmap.md). The build writes the navigation from this file and the app renders the panels from it. Sentences never contain an en or em dash (D-029).

sections.title: Uploads and inputs
sections.summary: The client's files, the analyst's inputs and the month's reference data that a review starts from. Every upload will pass the Upload, Validate, Preview and Review stages before it feeds the review.

arriving.what: Base file upload with the Upload, Validate, Preview and Review stages, the import report, the editable family label and the disclaimer in use
Fund monitor uploads, read by column name, with their data dates
Transactions (IRR) file, and the analyst's price file for direct equity
PMS and AIF look-through statements and bond holdings, as two clear inputs
Review mode selector: Portfolio Review Only from M5, Portfolio Review with Rebalancing from M8
Workbook re-upload, with the report of any replaced formula
Capital-gains statement in the app's own template, with the blank template to download
MF Screener data pack (the slot below)

slots.title: MF Screener data pack
slots.text: Upload the pack the Screener owner exports (pr-datapack_<cycle>.zip) once per Screener cycle. It will be checked in this browser and kept in this browser only, until a newer pack is loaded. It is never published, never committed and never sent anywhere (D-026). Until then, Screener scores and ranks are not shown.
